item.title: Israel, Greece finalize €3 billion defense system agreement
item.description:
Israel and Greece signed a 3 billion euro defense agreement on Monday, Israel's defense ministry announced, under which Israel will build a "multi layered" system dubbed "Achilles Shield" — one of Greece's largest-ever defence deals. The deal also expands industrial cooperation, including tech transfer to Greek industry, and includes David's Sling, Spyder and Barak MX, Reuters reported, alongside a 26 million euro drone dome sale.

item.title: Sanchez blames Israel, Russia for 'disinformation' over Ceuta migrant crisis
item.description:
Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez said Monday that Russia and Israel spread disinformation tied to last month's migrant surge into Ceuta, citing EU research. Reuters reported Sanchez called it "evident" the two countries used the crisis to criticize Madrid, while he ruled out any Moroccan role in the influx.
